sectionOfrecemos.heading: Fair enough — what do we offer?
sectionOfrecemos.subtitle: Our services
sectionOfrecemos.s1title: We build digital, automated systems that take repetitive human work out of the loop
sectionOfrecemos.s1body: We build digital systems in place of the work you and your team do today that burns time and does not add real value to the business. Saving time on work that should be automated is a basic need. Let a machine run the repeatables while you invest in what actually matters.
sectionOfrecemos.s2title: We add intelligence to your digital processes so you can make better calls
sectionOfrecemos.s2body: We build flows that can decide in a 100% autonomous (or near-autonomous) way, so no one has to spend hours gathering information, processing it, interpreting it and only then choosing. We define clear, business-specific criteria and then automate their application, end to end, with the guardrails you want.
sectionOfrecemos.s3title: We make your company's digital operations easier to read
sectionOfrecemos.s3body: We cut through the fog of your digital process landscape, what it is for, and where it pays off, so you and the business always know which tool is in play, why, and at what value. We ground that in numbers whenever it helps you steer better.

quienes.title: Who we are
quienes.subtitle: Your partner to modernize operations without getting lost along the way
quienes.lead: We are a team of software engineers and automated systems architects.
quienes.body1: We use the latest market technologies — including artificial intelligence — to empower small and medium-sized businesses in their internal and external workflows.
quienes.body2: No fluff, no empty promises. Concrete, measurable solutions tailored to your business.

comoTrabajamos.heading: How we work
comoTrabajamos.subtitle: Because the system amplifies the result
comoTrabajamos.s1body: We identify the problems slowing down your operations and the improvements you can implement.
comoTrabajamos.s2body: We present concrete options with estimated benefits: time saved or money recovered.
comoTrabajamos.s3body: We work with you collaboratively until you have a clear picture of what we are going to build and how.
comoTrabajamos.s4body: We deliver a first working system — what others call an MVP, we call it an MVS — so you see results fast.
comoTrabajamos.s5body: We complete the solution while you can see at every step what state it is in, with partial deliveries and no surprises.
comoTrabajamos.s6body: We guide the rollout so the solution fits your real processes from day one.
comoTrabajamos.s7body: If needed, we train your team. We leave the system fully operational and ready for you.
comoTrabajamos.s8body: Weeks or months later, the results speak for themselves: less time, fewer errors, more money on the table.

links.tagline: Automation and AI for your business

hero.h1: If we don't save you money, you don't pay.
hero.sub: We automate your company's repetitive work and only charge for the measured savings.
hero.sub2: No hype, no PowerPoints, no fee just for sitting down to talk.

como.heading: How it works
como.subtitle: Three steps, zero risk
como.s1body: We quantify what the process costs you today: your team's hours, errors, rework. This part is free.
como.s2body: We build the system and leave it running inside your real operations, without changing how you work more than necessary.
como.s3body: We compare before and after. If the savings can't be measured, there's no invoice.
como.note: We explain the exact mechanics in the first conversation. No strings attached.

ejemplos.heading: How much money is that?
ejemplos.subtitle: Illustrative examples
ejemplos.e1body: Invoices built by hand copying data from delivery notes and emails.
ejemplos.e2body: Orders arrive by email and someone re-types them into the ERP.
ejemplos.e3body: Reports filled in by hand that someone later copies into the computer.
ejemplos.e4body: Checking which invoices are unpaid and claiming them one by one.
ejemplos.e5body: The same summary spreadsheet, built by hand month after month.
ejemplos.disclaimer: Indicative figures based on an €18/hour staff cost. We measure your real numbers with you, for free.
ejemplos.stamp: If the savings can't be measured, there's no invoice.

humo.heading: We don't sell you AI
humo.subtitle: No hype
humo.body1: We're not here to talk about artificial intelligence or the latest trend. We're here to take away hours of work that add nothing.
humo.body2: We use whatever tool fits each case — and it's almost always normal, boring, reliable software. When AI helps, we use it; when it doesn't, we don't.
humo.body3: You don't pay for the technology. You pay for the savings.

quienes.heading: Who we are

calc.heading: How much is a manual process costing you?
calc.sub: Think of one specific process in your company (invoicing, entering orders, preparing reports…) and move the sliders.
calc.note: Rough estimate over 47 working weeks. It won't replace your accounting: it shows the order of magnitude of what staying the same costs.

ba.eyebrow: A real process, before and after
ba.heading: The same order, with and without software

casos.heading: Processes we've already seen lose money
casos.c1story: A haulier couldn't invoice each delivery until the signed CMR came back in the truck's folder, weeks later. We built a system where the driver photographs the document on delivery and the invoice goes out the same day.
casos.c2story: Mechanics logged their hours on paper and some of them never made it to the invoice. We built a system where every job is clocked from a tablet and the repair order collects real hours and parts.
casos.c3story: Orders came in by phone and WhatsApp, and someone re-typed them into delivery notes every morning, in a rush and with mistakes. We built a system that turns every order into a delivery note without typing anything.
casos.note: Example cases with indicative figures, based on processes common in SMEs. We measure your real numbers with you before starting.
casos.c4story: Knowing which machine was on which site, until when, and whether its inspection was up to date lived in three spreadsheets. We built a fleet panel with contracts, maintenance alerts and automatic daily billing.
casos.c5story: Quoting while the material price changed every week meant selling at a loss without knowing it. We built a quoting calculator connected to the day's price: a quote in minutes, no surprises.

metodo.heading: We measure before, we measure after
metodo.s1b: We analyse how much time and money the process consumes today. With data, not feelings.
metodo.s2b: Together we set a concrete number the solution has to reach.
metodo.s3b: We create a small, specific solution for that process. Nothing more.
metodo.s4b: We measure the real result on the working process.

garantia.heading: We agree the result before starting.
garantia.body: If the solution doesn't reach the agreed target, we don't charge for the development.
garantia.sub: The project risk is ours, not yours.

ctaFinal.heading: Show us a process that wastes your time.

ctaFinal.waText: Hi, we have a process that wastes our time and I'd like you to analyse it.

hacemos.heading: What we do
hacemos.c1b: We find the process that loses you hours every week: re-typed orders, paperwork going back and forth, impossible spreadsheets.
hacemos.c2b: We create a small, specific tool that removes that work. No never-ending projects: weeks, not months.
hacemos.c3b: We compare before and after in hours and euros. If there are no measured savings, we don't charge for the project.
